Profile.title: About Maria Basso
Profile.description: Multi-disciplinary graphic designer available for remote work in US, Canada and Worldwide.
Profile.availability: Available for remote work for US, Canada and Worldwide.

aircraft.title: Customizable Aircraft Poster
aircraft.description: The client needed a fully customizable poster for their e-commerce of aviation posters. I designed a modular template in Figma inspired by the International Typographic Style, maintaining a minimalist and highly readable aesthetic. The file was structured with variables and modifiable components, allowing for quick updates of names, statistics, and technical specifications of different aircraft without compromising the layout.

bascorp.title: Brand Identity for Bascorp
bascorp.description: Bascorp is a startup focused on developing innovative solutions for the construction industry. The client needed a comprehensive brand identity that could effectively communicate their values of innovation, sustainability, and reliability. I developed a visual identity system that included logo design, typography, color palette, and digital applications. The design was inspired by the principles of modernism and minimalism, with a focus on clarity and functionality to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.

magazine.title: Editorial Design for a Cultural Magazine: "Il Raccoglitore"
magazine.description: A project for a cultural magazine I founded with a group of friends. I handled the editorial design (print and digital), typography, and social and promotional content. The design was developed to work in both digital and printed format, with particular attention to readability and contemporary aesthetics.

petrha-aquadro.title: Brand Identity for Petrha Srl and Aquadro Holding
petrha-aquadro.description: Petrha Srl is a construction company aiming to establish itself among the leading design & build firms. The client needed a comprehensive brand identity to effectively communicate their values of innovation, sustainability, and reliability. Aquadro Holding is the group Petrha Srl belongs to — I extended the visual identity developed for Petrha to cover the holding as well, creating a coherent system applicable across all digital and print touchpoints.

petrha.title: Petrha Group Visual Identity
petrha.description: Visual identity and digital experience design for Petrha Group, a design & build construction company. The project focused on establishing a strong brand presence across digital platforms.

torrechannel.title: TC.it Brand Identity
torrechannel.description: Brand identity design for TC.it, including logo design and visual system development.

loud.title: Loud: Against Bullying
loud.description: Concept for a campaign against bullying, developed as a personal project. The focus is on text and visual communication, with a direct and impactful approach to raise awareness on this social issue.

stasifood.title: Stasifood Packaging & rebranding
stasifood.description: Concept for packaging and branding of Stasifood, including logo design, packaging concepts, and digital applications with a focus on creating a coherent visual identity and premium brand presence.

shineshield.title: Shine & Shield Brand Identity
shineshield.description: Spec work for designing the visual identity of Shine & Shield, including logo design and visual system development.

fantasybook.title: Editorial Design for Fantasy Book
fantasybook.description: Editorial design project for a fantasy book, with particular attention to typography, visual hierarchy, and stylistic consistency between cover and internal layout.

bookLayout.title: Book Layout Design for Print and Digital
bookLayout.description: <up>Every well written book</up> deserves a layout that enhances the reading experience. I specialize in designing layouts for both print and digital formats, ensuring that your content is presented in the most engaging and readable way possible. Whether you're publishing a novel, a non-fiction book, or a photo book, I can create a layout that reflects your vision and meets the technical requirements of your chosen publishing platform.

items.question: What formats do you deliver?
items.answer: I deliver print-ready PDFs and EPUBs for digital distribution. If you only need one format, we'll decide together based on your platform and needs.

items.question: Do you work with KDP?
items.answer: Yes, I set up layouts following Amazon KDP's technical specs — margins, bleed, image resolution, and file format are all configured to upload without issues.

items.question: What do I need to get started?
items.answer: Your manuscript in Word or a similar format, any images or illustrations in high resolution, and a rough idea of the style you have in mind. I'll take care of the rest.

items.question: Do you work with illustrated books or books with images?
items.answer: Yes, I handle layouts with text, images, and illustrations — novels, non-fiction, photography books, manuals.

items.question: Can I choose the fonts?
items.answer: Yes. If you already have something in mind I'll help you evaluate it; if you're starting from scratch I'll suggest the best options for your book's genre and audience.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Turnaround depends on the length and complexity of the book. We'll agree on a timeline before starting, so you have a clear delivery date from the beginning.

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: Two revisions are included in the price, allowing you to request adjustments after reviewing the layout at no extra cost.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Yes, I work with both Italian and international clients. I communicate fluently in Italian and English.

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.description: Reach out by email or through the contact form. Tell me about your project — genre, length, publishing platform, and timeline. I'll get back to you within 24 hours with a tailored quote.

steps.title: Briefing and kickoff
steps.description: For more complex projects, we'll align on style, fonts, and visual references. Once we're on the same page, I will start working.

steps.title: Draft and revisions
steps.description: You'll receive a complete first draft of the layout. Two rounds of revisions are included — nothing is considered final until you're happy with the result.

steps.title: Final delivery
steps.description: Once the draft is approved, you receive the final files — print-ready PDF and/or EPUB, ready to upload to KDP.
